name: Hegic WBTC puts pool withdraw never reduces the tranche's share
summary: The Hegic WBTC ATM puts pool let the holder of a tranche withdraw it without marking the tranche closed, so a depositor with a dust tranche repeated the same 0.0025 WBTC withdrawal a hundred times in one transaction and drained 0.25 WBTC.
notes: The pool is unchanged since its deployment 3.1 years earlier; its later storage writes are tranches and accounting. The attacker's deposit tx 0x49af686d set up the dust tranche.
